title.zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Cyber 网络安全模型
title.en: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber cybersecurity model

current_state.zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Cyber，这是一款专注于网络安全的AI模型，该公司称其在测试中更擅长发现漏洞，越界比例低于1%。
current_state.en: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity-focused AI model that it says is better at finding vulnerabilities while going out of bounds less than 1 percent of the time during testing.

updates.title_zh: GPT‑6 Cyber：推进对齐网络安全智能体的前沿
updates.title_en: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Cyber，这是一款专注于网络安全的模型，旨在发现可利用漏洞并开发修复方案，同时保持在授权范围内。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity-focused model built to find exploitable vulnerabilities and develop fixes while staying within authorized scope.
updates.current_state_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Cyber，这是一款专注于网络安全的模型，旨在发现可利用漏洞并开发修复方案，同时保持在授权范围内。
updates.current_state_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity-focused model built to find exploitable vulnerabilities and develop fixes while staying within authorized scope.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity-focused model built to find exploitable vulnerabilities and develop fixes while staying within authorized scope.
updates.detailed_summary_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity-focused model built to find exploitable vulnerabilities and develop fixes while staying within authorized scope.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6 Cyber：专攻网络安全漏洞，风险评级升至「关键」
updates.title_en: OpenAI发布GPT-6 Cyber：专攻网络安全漏洞，风险评级升至「关键」
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI向一小部分经过审核的客户发布了GPT-6 Cyber，并将其网络安全风险评级从上一代「高」上调至「关键」；同时披露该模型发现81个高严重性Firefox漏洞、协助开发针对948个Linux内核漏洞的可用利用程序，并已向「Daybreak Red」层级特定客户开放。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber to a small set of vetted customers, raised its cybersecurity risk rating from High to Critical, disclosed findings of 81 high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities and working exploits for 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities, and made it available to select customers in the Daybreak Red tier.
updates.current_state_zh: GPT-6 Cyber已向经过审核的安全客户发布，风险评级升至「关键」，并展示了发现和利用高危漏洞的能力；OpenAI计划未来几周扩展至所有获批客户，同时开放早期GPT-5.6 Cyber模型。
updates.current_state_en: GPT-6 Cyber has been released to vetted security customers, its risk rating has been raised to Critical, and it has demonstrated vulnerability discovery and exploit development; OpenAI plans broader access to approved customers in the coming weeks and is also making an earlier GPT-5.6 Cyber model available.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber to vetted security customers, raised its cybersecurity risk rating to Critical, and demonstrated the model's ability to uncover high-severity Firefox and Linux kernel vulnerabilities and develop working exploits.
updates.detailed_summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber to vetted security customers, raised its cybersecurity risk rating to Critical, and demonstrated the model's ability to uncover high-severity Firefox and Linux kernel vulnerabilities and develop working exploits.
